title: Browser console errors detected
problem: The live homepage emitted browser errors.
recommendation: Investigate the affected client-side dependency before changing unrelated code.

title: Homepage lacks a meta description
problem: The rendered homepage has no meta description, which weakens link previews and search-result context.
evidence: Playwright: meta[name="description"] was not found on /.
expected: The homepage provides a concise meta description.
recommendation: Add a task-scoped meta description to public/index.html.
